Underlying literary work and edition are treated as public domain for this authority. Wikimedia community text-layer reuse is conservatively attributed through the permanent source URL. Redistribution of this snapshot must preserve this attribution notice and a CC BY-SA license notice/link as required by the Wikimedia Terms of Use; where GFDL applies, reusers may comply with that license instead when the Terms permit.

Normalization changes from the rendered approved page: MediaWiki chrome and scan image omitted; leading non-breaking-space stanza markers converted to blank-line stanza boundaries; Unicode NFC; LF line endings; one final LF. No spelling modernization or content correction was performed.

This qualification does not admit generic Ukrainian Wikisource content, modern translations, or CC-BY-SA-only original works.
